args: k="$HOME/.config/plangraph/omniroute-mgmt.key"; [ -r "$k" ] || echo "plangraph spawner: gateway log key unreadable: $k" >&2; export PLANGRAPH_GATEWAY_LOG_TOKEN="$([ -r "$k" ] && tr -d '\r\n' < "$k" 2>/dev/null)"; u="$HOME/.config/plangraph"/omniroute-base-url; v="$([ -r "$u" ] && tr -d '\r\n' < "$u" 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$v" ] && export OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL="$v"; [ -n "${OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL:-}" ] || echo "plangraph spawner: gateway base URL unset: $u" >&2; exec python3 -m plangraph.spawner.mcp
